The '''narvaxx''' was a four-legged [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] living in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Several captured narvaxx were used by Doctor [[Sannus Lorrick]] in his experiments with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] in his [[Lost Island|base]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. A giant infected narvaxx called [[Toxxun]] was spotted during the [[rakghoul pandemic]] in the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Behind the scenes==
Narvaxx were created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Content in game files indicated that narvaxx were intended to appear as the wildlife on [[Denova]] and also provide a depiction of an unaltered narvaxx. The only narvaxx who appear in the actual game are infected with the rakghoul plague, during the "Lost Island" flashpoint and as a Rakghoul Event World Boss on Corellia.
